caption: The drawing depicts a circular bowl-like object with a raised rim, shaded in grayscale pencil. Attached to the upper side of the bowl is an ornate, symmetrical handle or decorative extension with a design consisting of swirling, interconnected loops, heart, and cross shapes. The image is set against a plain background within a faint rectangular frame. In the bottom right corner, there is a small, detailed diagram showing a side view of the bowl with a labeled dimension of "5,” a set of initials “M C” beneath a “W” shape, and a line indicating the depth of the bowl as "1 3/4". The bottom left of the image features the name "Hester Duany" written in small letters. The overall drawing uses shades of grey and black pencil on a slightly yellowed background.
title: Silver Porringer
